rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Decree No. 663 of 1 October 1992, issued by the President of the Republic under Article 84(IV) to consolidate the regulation of the National Treasury Note (Law No. 8.249 of 1991), is dated Brasília 1 October 1992 and signed Fernando Collor (countersigned Marcílio Marques Moreira); the page notes publication in the DOU of 2 October 1992.
